scripts.dev: vp run --filter '@agentctl/*' compile && vp run --parallel --filter '@agentctl/*' dev
scripts.dev:web: vp run --filter '@agentctl/web...' --filter '@agentctl/server...' compile && vp run --parallel --filter '@agentctl/web...' --filter '@agentctl/server...' dev
scripts.dev:desktop: vp run --filter '@agentctl/desktop...' --filter '@agentctl/ui...' --filter '@agentctl/api-client...' compile && vp run --parallel --filter '@agentctl/desktop...' --filter '!@agentctl/server' --filter '@agentctl/ui...' --filter '@agentctl/api-client...' dev
scripts.clean: find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find packages apps -name dist -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find packages apps -type d -name .vite-plus -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find packages apps -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -type f -delete 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .vite-plus
scripts.ui:check: pnpm --filter @agentctl/web exec vp build --mode gallery && node apps/web/scripts/performance-browser.mjs --gallery
scripts.check: pnpm architecture:check && vp check && vp run --filter '@agentctl/*' types
scripts.perf:backend: pnpm exec vp run --filter '@agentctl/server...' compile && pnpm --filter @agentctl/server perf:baseline
scripts.perf:desktop: pnpm exec vp run --filter '@agentctl/desktop...' compile && node scripts/performance/desktop.mjs
